jobDescription:
SAP FICO Senior Consultant

Location: Frankfurt, Germany / Hybrid (2 days on-site)
Employment: Full-time, permanent

About the Role
We are a mid-sized manufacturing group running SAP S/4HANA and are looking for a Senior SAP FICO Consultant to own the finance and controlling side of our template and lead rollouts across our European subsidiaries.

Key Responsibilities
- Configure and maintain SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) and Controlling (CO), including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Asset Accounting.
- Design and run Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA).
- Lead FICO workstreams in S/4HANA rollout and migration projects.
- Gather requirements directly from finance stakeholders and translate them into configuration.
- Write functional specifications for RICEFW developments and coordinate with ABAP developers.
- Support month-end and year-end close from the systems side.

Required Skills
- 5+ years hands-on SAP FICO configuration
- Deep SAP S/4HANA Finance experience
- General Ledger, AP, AR, Asset Accounting configuration
- Cost Center Accounting and CO-PA
- Requirements gathering with business stakeholders
- Functional specification writing

Languages (required)
- German: business fluent (C1) — you will run workshops with German-speaking finance teams
- English: professional working proficiency

Nice to Have
- SAP Activate methodology
- Experience with a manufacturing / discrete industry template
- SAP S/4HANA Finance certification
